title: How long does standard shipping take?
question: How long does standard shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping usually takes 3–5 business days within the continental United States.

title: Do you offer express delivery?
question: Do you offer express delivery?
answer: Yes, express shipping is available at checkout and typically delivers within 1–2 business days for an additional fee.

title: Is international shipping available?
question: Is international shipping available?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries, with delivery times ranging from 7–14 business days depending on destination.

title: How much does shipping cost?
question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50; orders under $50 incur a flat $5.99 shipping fee.

title: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
answer: You can update your shipping address within 1 hour of placing the order by contacting customer support, provided it hasn't shipped yet.

title: What happens if my package is delayed?
question: What happens if my package is delayed?
answer: If your package is delayed beyond the estimated delivery window, contact support with your order number and we'll investigate with the carrier.

title: How do I track my order?
question: How do I track my order?
answer: You'll receive a tracking link via email once your order ships; you can also track it from the Orders section of your account.

title: Do you ship to PO boxes?
question: Do you ship to PO boxes?
answer: Standard shipping supports PO boxes, but express and international shipping do not.

title: What carriers do you use?
question: What carriers do you use?
answer: We primarily ship via UPS, FedEx, and USPS depending on your location and shipping method.

title: Can I schedule a specific delivery date?
question: Can I schedule a specific delivery date?
answer: We currently don't support scheduled delivery dates, but express shipping can help you receive your order faster.

title: Do you offer same-day delivery?
question: Do you offer same-day delivery?
answer: Same-day delivery is available in select metro areas for orders placed before 12 PM local time.

title: What if no one is home to receive my package?
question: What if no one is home to receive my package?
answer: Carriers will typically leave the package in a safe location or attempt redelivery; you can also request signature-free delivery at checkout.

title: Why is my order shipping in multiple packages?
question: Why is my order shipping in multiple packages?
answer: Items in stock at different warehouses may ship separately to get them to you faster.

title: Can I combine multiple orders into one shipment?
question: Can I combine multiple orders into one shipment?
answer: Orders placed separately cannot be combined once submitted, even if placed on the same day.

title: Do shipping costs vary by shoe weight or size?
question: Do shipping costs vary by shoe weight or size?
answer: No, shipping costs are based on order total and delivery method, not individual item weight.

title: Is shipping insurance included?
question: Is shipping insurance included?
answer: All orders include basic shipping protection against loss or damage during transit.

title: What is the cutoff time for same-day order processing?
question: What is the cutoff time for same-day order processing?
answer: Orders placed before 1 PM local time are typically processed and shipped the same business day.

title: Do you ship on weekends?
question: Do you ship on weekends?
answer: Orders are processed Monday through Friday; orders placed on weekends ship the next business day.

title: How do I know if my item is in stock before ordering?
question: How do I know if my item is in stock before ordering?
answer: Product availability is shown in real time on each product page prior to checkout.

title: What happens if I refuse a delivery?
question: What happens if I refuse a delivery?
answer: Refused deliveries are returned to our warehouse and refunded once received, minus any return shipping fees if applicable.

title: Can I pick a different shipping carrier?
question: Can I pick a different shipping carrier?
answer: Currently we select the carrier based on destination and speed; manual carrier selection isn't supported.

title: Do you charge customs or import duties for international orders?
question: Do you charge customs or import duties for international orders?
answer: International orders may be subject to customs fees and import duties, which are the responsibility of the customer.

title: How can I expedite an order after it's placed?
question: How can I expedite an order after it's placed?
answer: Contact customer support as soon as possible; we can upgrade shipping if the order hasn't entered fulfillment yet.

title: What should I do if tracking shows delivered but I didn't receive my package?
question: What should I do if tracking shows delivered but I didn't receive my package?
answer: Check with neighbors and your building's mailroom first, then contact support within 48 hours to file a claim.

title: Do you offer free shipping for members?
question: Do you offer free shipping for members?
answer: Rewards members receive free standard shipping on all orders regardless of order total.
